conviction_note: Nothing unpriced found: the H2 guide (OP 345m against 1,495m a year earlier) is visibly conservative and has been public and commented on since July, the neighbouring Toho Gas 期ずれ swing that probably weighs on Jun-Aug is inside that guide, and SALA has never revised at a Q3 print, so the release most likely adds a seasonally small quarter and a held forecast; the per-finding sum nets to 0.0 and p_up 50 on an abs move of 2.3 gives 0.0.
bar: Company FY11/2026 forecast as revised 2026-07-07: sales 260,000m, OP 7,800m, ordinary 9,400m, NP 5,900m, DPS 34 (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260707/140120260707588637.pdf), which implies H2 OP of 345m and H2 ordinary of 878m (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2734). No IFIS or 四季報 number reachable; the only outside coverage is sponsored Fisco research, which calls the FY OP guide 'やや保守的' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2734&b=n202608100387). So the bar is the company plan only and every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-09-29: no disclosed position at or above 0.5% (real zero, no change). 信用倍率 18.8x (kabutan stock page 2026-10-06, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=2734), a crowded margin long. No options and no skew. Price fell from 1,245 (09-28) to 1,158 this morning, about -7% in six sessions with no company disclosure behind it (TDnet scanned 09-01 to 10-06: only the 09-03 buyback progress report), so some pre-print de-risking by leveraged longs may already have happened; an unexplained drawdown is sized at 0.

findings.finding: SALA has not filed a full-year 業績予想の修正 with any Q3 決算短信 from FY11/2013 through FY11/2025 (its revisions land at Q1, H1 or in late December), so the obvious upside catalyst of a raised FY guide on today's print is unlikely and the release will most likely hold the 7,800m OP plan despite H1 already being at 95.6% of it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Held forecasts at the last four Q3 prints were followed by next-close moves of about +2.5% (2022), +1.8% (2023), +1.3% (2024) and -0.6% (2025) from Yahoo daily closes (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2734.T?range=5y&interval=1d); the H1 raise on 2026-07-07 was bought +3.1% the next session.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-06 (disclosure list read on this date, entries dated 2013-09-24 to 2026-07-07)
findings.why_not_priced: It mostly is priced: a holder who has followed the name knows the company does not revise at Q3. The only unpriced part is the margin long (18.8x) that bought the August/September run to all-time highs on the conservative-guide thesis and may want a raise; if that hope were already gone the stock would not have printed a 上場来高値 in mid-September (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2734&b=n202609190140). The 7% slide into the print suggests some of it has gone already.

findings.finding: Neighbouring city-gas utility Toho Gas reported that its 原料費調整 期ずれ swung from gain to loss in Apr-Jun 2026 (OP -61.5% YoY) after the Middle East/Hormuz LNG price rise, so SALA's city-gas margin in Jun-Aug is probably hit the same way and the Q3 quarter could print at or below zero OP against +204m a year earlier; this is the risk SALA itself cited when it set H2 OP at 345m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 is SALA's seasonally weakest quarter (Jun-Aug OP -263m in FY24, +204m in FY25, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2734&mode=k); the FY24 loss quarter was followed by +1.3% to the next close. No record of the stock reacting to a city-gas lag swing specifically.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced and guided: SALA's own 2026-07-07 notice cut implied H2 OP to 345m citing 中東情勢 (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260707/140120260707588637.pdf), and the Toho Gas print has been public for ten weeks. What is not priced is the exact Q3 number and the kabutan headline a loss quarter would carry ('6-8月期は赤字転落') for a 49% retail register with a crowded margin long. If the market had not absorbed the guide, the stock would not have hit all-time highs after it.
findings.independence: SALA's own revision notice names the same Middle East risk (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260707/140120260707588637.pdf); a different document, but it is the company guiding for the effect, which is why this sits near 0.

findings.finding: H1 OP of 7,455m is already 95.6% of the 7,800m FY plan, and the plan's implied H2 OP of 345m compares with H2 OP of 1,419m (FY24) and 1,495m (FY25) and Q4 OP of 1,682m and 1,291m in those years, so unless Jun-Aug is a loss of about 450m or worse the nine-month OP will sit at or above about 90% of the full-year plan, with a Q4 to come that has always been profitable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26 (ordinary +41%, an obvious beat on progress) was bought +4.4% on 2026-04-07 and the H1 beat-and-raise +3.1% on 2026-07-08 (Yahoo daily closes); the last four Q3 prints moved +2.5, +1.8, +1.3 and -0.6 to the next close.
findings.why_not_priced: The conservatism is public (Fisco 2026-08-10 calls the guide 'やや保守的') and the stock ran to all-time highs on it, so most is priced. What is left is the 進捗率 headline at nine months, which kabutan prints mechanically and which this retail-heavy register reacts to; if it were fully priced the stock would not have given back 7% into the print with no news.
findings.independence: Fisco research memo 2026-08-10 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2734&b=n202608100387) reaches the same conservative-guide read from the same numbers; it is not an independent fact.

outside_window.finding: The 2026-03-02 buyback (up to 2.0m shares / 3.0bn yen, to 2026-11-30) was 77.75% complete by shares at 2026-08-31, with August buying slowed to 125,700 shares; completion and any new authorisation are more likely at the FY print in January than at Q3.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely, SALA has never revised at a Q3 print 2013-2025, and the FY plan is visibly conservative so a hold is not a disappointment to anyone who knows the name. Returns: buyback already running to 2026-11-30, no Q3 return announcements in prior years; 34 yen DPS already raised in July. New-year guide: not this print (FY print is January, and January 2026's first guide moved the stock -10%). Quarter: Jun-Aug is the seasonal low (OP -263m FY24, +204m FY25); nine-month OP progress likely ~90-100% of plan against ~83% (6,090/7,381 on final actuals) last year.

baseline_tension: Priced lean -0.47 (margin overhang 18.8x) and a -3.3% 20-day run-up; my findings net to zero, and the strongest positive the release could carry (a nine-month OP at or above the full-year plan, with the guide held as usual) was looked for and is filed at +0.4, while the two negatives are both inside a guide the company set in July, so I do not lean with the positioning.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (negative resting on a series the market already has): the Toho Gas lag finding rests on a peer print public since July and on SALA's own July guide, so it moved from -0.3 to -0.2; p_up moved from 48 to 50.
Rule 1 also applied to the no-Q3-revision finding, which anyone can read off the disclosure list: -0.3 to -0.2.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension; the +0.4 progress-rate finding was already in the draft, so it was left unchanged.
Open question 4 (a five-day run-in is not a short signal): the -3.4% five-day slide was already sized at 0 as an unexplained drawdown; nothing changed.
